BETWEEN:-
 JAIDEV RAIKWAR S/O POORANLAL RAIKWAR, AGED  ABOUT 25 YEARS, OCCUPATION:

LABOUR R/O VILLAGE  D HAN GOUR P.S. TENDUKHERA DISTRICT DAMOH  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI SHARAD VERMA - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION TENDUKHEDA DISTRICT DAMOH (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI S. K. SHRIVASTAVA - GOVT. ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER 1.

This is first application filed by applicant under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of anticipatory bail relating to Crime No. 157/2024 registered at Police Station- Tendukheda District-Damoh for the offences under Sections 376(2)(N), 365, 366, 506, 109 of the IPC.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant relied on the statement of one Tulsiram Thakur dated 9.1.2024.
It is submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
Prosecutrix on her own has gone along with the applicant.
In these circumstances, applicant may be released on anticipatory bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed t h e anticipatory bail application and submitted that statement of Tulsiram Thakur is not available in the case diary.

As per prosecution case and statement of prosecutrix, one Durga Sahu called prosecutrix out of her house Jaidev Raikwar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146156592/
1 to give water.

sentences.text: When she arrived out of the house, she was kidnapped by the applicant.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5. Considering the nature of allegations, anticipatory bail application filed by the applicant is dismissed.
(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE AD/
